title: Camps C4 (Edit payment) + C5 — Undo for 5 seconds after Camps’ saves
subtitle: Rule v1.006 (rule 1.4): every change that can be reversed shows Undo for 5 seconds. Rule v1.003: Edit payment ends with “Payment changed” + Undo — the words and look of Black Belt’s built Edit payment toast (TOAST_PAYMENT_CHANGED). The shared Toast, unchanged: bottom-right on PC and tablet, bottom-center above the bottom bar on phones; the 5 seconds pause while the pointer or focus is on it. PC 1280×800. Amber = what changes. (“Undo payment asks first” is the other half of C4 — it waits for the shared confirm box.)

items.caption: Edit payment (admin, from the ⋯): “Payment saved”, no Undo.
Edit camp (Camps list pencil, camp page header): “Camp saved”, no Undo.
Save as template (camp ⋯): “Template saved · April Vacation Camp”, no Undo.

row.caption: … and Restore. Also Change how they’ll pay, Close / Reopen sign-up, check-ins.

items.caption: “Payment changed” · Undo (Black Belt’s words). Undo saves the old amount / way / date again on the new payment record, as Black Belt does (no database change).
“Camp saved” · Undo — saves the camp’s old values again. Can be refused (a family picked a newly added day, v0.701; or 0027’s edit guard): then the amber bar says why.
“Template saved” · Undo — saves the template’s old values again.
“Changes saved” · Undo — saves the camper’s old details again. See the question below.
“Template saved · April Vacation Camp” · Undo — deletes the new template (as Add camp’s Undo deletes the new camp).

footer: Question for Jeffrey — what a camper’s Undo can’t bring back: if Edit details changed the days, the member box or the extras, the database prices the whole camper again at the camp’s current prices (rule v0.700; camp_update_details, 0022_camps_weekly_pricing.sql lines 1419–1423). Undo saves the old details, which prices the camper again too — so if the camp’s prices changed since the sign-up, the old total may not come back (the child’s days and extras do). Options: (a) Undo as drawn, and the Camper detail shows the new total; (b) Undo only for changes that don’t re-price (names, age, family), none after days / member / extras changes. Recommendation: (a) — it is what a person re-typing the old values would get today. Other toasts checked, not changed: “Kept both sign-ups” (no Undo today; not in v1.006’s list), “Payment undone for X” (C4’s other half), Close / Open sign-up’s words (picture 6: “Sign-up open”, proposal). Script: mock-c05-toast.js.
